- Exploit-DB 22271: Cisco IOS 11/12 - OSPF Neighbor Buffer Overflow (remote/hardware, 2003-02-20, verified=1)

### CVE-2003-0567
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2003-07-25 | Updated: 2024-08-08 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 60: Cisco IOS - 'cisco-bug-44020.c' IPv4 Packet Denial of Service (dos/hardware, 2003-07-21, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 59: Cisco IOS - IPv4 Packets Denial of Service (dos/hardware, 2003-07-18, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 62: Cisco IOS - using hping Remote Denial of Service (dos/hardware, 2003-07-22, verified=1)

Cisco IOS 11.x and 12.0 through 12.2 allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (traffic block) by sending a particular sequence of IPv4 packets to an interface on the device, causing the input queue on that interface to be marked as full.
